JE LEVEL 1 STUDENT WORKBOOK


Your Thinking Tools
My name                                                                                             Date
1. The Butterfly Hug

 1. Cross your arms over your chest, like butterfly wings.
 2. Tap left, right, left, right, slowly.
 3. Breathe in slowly, breathe out slowly.
 4. Keep going for one minute. Now your brain is in the Green Zone.

        I can do the Butterfly Hug by myself.

2. The Talking Stone. Only the person holding the stone speaks. When you are not
holding it, you listen. Pass the stone when you are finished.

        I can listen while someone else holds the stone.

3. Hands for my idea. Open hands for my idea. Hands together for my because.
Draw your open hands                                                         Draw your hands together




    I think                 because                                                  . This is the sentence you will use all
    year. Every page helps you build it.

JE LEVEL 1 STUDENT WORKBOOK


Story 1: Mina and the Midnight Drum
My name                                                                                             Date
Lessons 1 to 4. Your teacher reads this story aloud from your printed Jurassic English
storybook.

    The big idea. Big and small sounds; wanting more; knowing when it is enough.

Who is in the story? Mina, Sami, Auntie. Listen for this line: “Mina has a small drum.”
(chapter 1)
My story map
Where?                                             Who?                                                What changed?




The book’s Word Fossils

  Word                                               What it means

  drum                                               You hit it to make music.

  ears                                               You hear with your ears.

  loud                                               A big, strong sound.

  soft                                               Gentle and quiet.

  tired                                              You need to rest or sleep.

  tomorrow                                           The day after today.

        I did my Butterfly Hug before we started.

Find the clue. How do you know the sound is too big for Sami? Find the clue on this page.

       He puts his hands over his ears.                              He plays the big drum.                         He goes to sleep.

My best Word Fossil today:



Grown-up: ask the child to say each word, show the face, and tell you when they felt it.
